moments.cue: These eight‑legged micro‑animals are only half a millimetre long
In the FOTON‑M3 mission, dehydrated tardigrades were taken into space
They entered a desiccated “tun” state, retracting their legs and sealing their bodies
When the capsule was opened back on Earth, only a portion of the tardigrades rehydrated
